summary: Core round-3 behavior is present and the automated suite/build pass, but the workspace is not release-ready yet: the shipped UI still exposes English product copy despite the Korean-language requirement, and the swap editor leaves its internal team summary data stale after edits.
strengths: `npm test` and `npm run build` both pass in the current workspace.
Header-present and headerless clipboard parsing both work, with Korean validation messages for bad input.
The compact 6-candidate preview flow, default candidate load, and two-click cross-role swap interaction are implemented and reproducible.
README and FINAL_OUTPUT document the new compact-preview/swap workflow and honestly call out the skipped real-browser check.

findings.title: User-facing UI is still mixed-language instead of Korean-only
findings.detail: The spec lists `product language in korean` as a must-have, but the shipped UI still renders English strings in primary result surfaces. `src/config/gameConfig.js:11`, `src/config/gameConfig.js:17`, and `src/config/gameConfig.js:23` define compact role badges as `TANK`, `DPS`, and `SUP`; `src/lib/render.js:86` renders `Final Edit`; and `src/constants/copy.js:26` shows `compact preview` in the main result hint. Rendering the result HTML from the sample fixture also confirmed these strings are present in the live output.
findings.fix: Translate all visible UI copy and role badges to Korean, then add a DOM-level test that fails if shipped UI text includes these English labels.

findings.title: Swap edits leave the editor's internal team model inconsistent
findings.detail: `src/lib/editor.js:26` only rehydrates `team.slots`, and `src/lib/editor.js:82` updates only those slots during swaps while copying the rest of each `team` object unchanged. That leaves `assignments`, `roleTotals`, `totalScore`, and `unrankedCount` frozen at the pre-swap candidate values. Reproduced with the sample fixture: after swapping `A-tank-1` and `B-support-2`, the visible slot changes to `하늘방패`, but `editor.teams[0].assignments` still reports `빛의수호` as the tank.
findings.fix: Rebuild each full `TeamSummary` from the current slot/player state on editor creation and after every swap, and add a unit test asserting that assignments and derived totals change with the swap.

required_fixes: Remove the remaining English product copy from the shipped UI (`Final Edit`, `compact preview`, `TANK/DPS/SUP`) so the product surface is fully Korean.
Make the editable team model internally coherent after swaps by recomputing assignments and derived team metrics, not just the rendered slots.
Add regression tests for both the Korean-only UI copy requirement and the post-swap team-summary consistency.
verification_run: `for name in chromium chromium-browser google-chrome google-chrome-stable microsoft-edge microsoft-edge-stable; do printf '%s: ' "$name"; command -v "$name" || true; done` — no Chromium-family browser found, so `npm run test:browser` could not be run here.

Node smoke script against `buildBalanceFromClipboard(...)` — confirmed 6 candidates render, the first candidate auto-loads into the editor, header/headerless input both parse, and cross-role swap refreshes visible tier text.
Node render check against `renderResult(...)` — confirmed live HTML still contains `Final Edit` and `TANK/DPS/SUP`.
Node state check against `applySlotSelection(...)` — confirmed swapped slot names update while `editor.teams[0].assignments` remains stale.
release_readiness: Not ready for release until the UI is fully localized to Korean and the swap editor rebuilds a coherent post-edit team model.
